subject: Lab camera bag and storage
text: I noticed the camera bag you mentioned for weekend hiking keeps bumping into the printer cart, and I wanted to offer a practical fix before it becomes a safety issue. If you keep it by the door, staff will need clear space when delivering reprints and toner, so maybe reserve the lower shelf in the supply closet instead. It is close enough to your office that you can drop it off between meetings, and it keeps lenses out of reach when students are moving around. On a separate note, your reply about macro photography was fun to read; it sounds like a good way to unwind after grading. If you ever want to share the field guide you mentioned, I can check whether our print budget covers a small run for the club. No rush. Just say the word and I can label a shelf, add a hook, or ask the facilities office to move the cart so the route stays clear. That should make the hobby feel supported without turning the corridor into an obstacle course. Also, if the bag has a wet trail section after rain, place a tray underneath so the shelf does not stain. I can pick one up on my next trip. If you start printing samples for a small exhibit, send me a list two weeks ahead so we can reserve table space without conflicting with seminar setup.
